injection.notes: Append a synthetic name to the career item's system.skills array. The name must not match any item in game.items (skill type). scan-career-refs uses game.items.contents.find(i=>i.name===name && i.type==='skill') — exact-name read-only fallback per Risk 2.A. Run scan-career-refs with scope={type:'actor', id:'<actor-id>'} and expect the synthetic name in details with refType='skill'.
